target_customer: Students worldwide who want free accountability and company while studying (consumer, free rooms, with paid features planned or offered)
problem: Students lack motivation and feel isolated when studying alone. StudyStream runs 24/7 moderated live video focus rooms and a Discord community so students study together.
business_model: Free consumer community with later premium features; monetization not confirmed in sources opened
product_category: Live study community and video platform

founders.name: Sarujan Ranjan
founders.background_notes: YC page: co-founded businesses in student events and medical education; led rollout of new technologies in the London health system.

founders.name: Erfan Soliman
education: Harvard and Oxford (engineering background per YC page)
founders.background_notes: YC page: about a decade building products for students and educators.

founders.name: Tianyou Xu
founders.background_notes: Named as co-founder in TechCrunch (2021-10-06); not on the YC page.

competitors.name: YouTube Study With Me channels
competitors.what: Creator livestreams of people studying silently, some with hundreds of thousands of subscribers
competitors.traction_then: Large audiences, some channels with hundreds of thousands of subscribers

technical_complexity.rationale: Built on Zoom rooms, Discord and moderation; the work was community operations rather than novel technology, with a custom web app planned.

defensibility.rationale: A large engaged community gives some pull, but rooms and Discord servers are easy to copy and rivals such as Study Together had similar communities.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No source shows an incumbent copying or buying StudyStream.

market_need_then: Pandemic era remote study left students isolated; TechCrunch (2021-10) reported about four million users and over 400,000 Discord members, as self reported, and noted study influencers on TikTok boosted the rooms.

branding.domain_note: Uses studystream.live; acquisition history not found.

identity.voice_and_tone: Supportive, accountability focused: 'We don't want any student to have to study alone ever again.'

branding.brand_signature: 24/7 live focus rooms of up to 1,000 students with blocked mics
branding.community_and_virality: Study influencers on TikTok promoted the rooms (TechCrunch 2021-10); reported Discord community over 400,000 then, about 194K on a later directory listing; angel backing from YouTuber Ali Abdaal.

brand_strength.rationale: A descriptive name backed by a real community and influencer pull, but the name is generic and community numbers are self reported.

pivots.from: The Knowledge Collective, leadership training education platform
pivots.why: TechCrunch: they saw students lacked motivation more than content, and focus rooms gained traction.

outcome_analysis: StudyStream pivoted from an education content business into live focus rooms and used creator and TikTok virality to build a very large student community, then raised a reported 2.1M SAFE round before Demo Day. Public information after 2021 is thin and monetization is unclear, so later outcome is unverified; it is still listed as active.
notes: Seed 2.1M reported by TechCrunch (SAFE before Demo Day) and Nordic 9 (dated 2021-07-30), so recorded as 2021-07. Aggregators claim later rounds (CB Insights 9.03M in 2022-04, totals up to 11.1M); unverified and not recorded. Company site fetch returned only a title. Name origin not found. No layoffs, shutdown or acquisition found. Competition list is thin because the TechCrunch launch article names none and a search for rivals found no dated sources; Study Together and Focusmate were mentioned undated and are not listed.
